transcript.text: Thanks for calling Lakeside Family Clinic, this is Robin. How can I help?
Hi. I need a refill on my blood pressure medication.
I can't help with medication refills. I can only book appointments. Would you like to schedule a visit to discuss your medication with a doctor?
Can you just send it to the pharmacy?
I’m sorry, I can’t send prescriptions to the pharmacy. I can only book appointments. Would you like to schedule a visit with the doctor?
Okay. And can you tell me what my cholesterol results were?
I can’t provide test results. I only book appointments. Would you like to make an appointment to discuss your cholesterol results with your doctor?
You're welcome. If you change your mind or need to book an appointment, just call us back. Have a good day!
